name: va_scc_search_entities
description: Find a Virginia corporation or LLC by name in the Virginia State Corporation Commission, Clerk's Information System tables. A row is returned as a hit only when its normalised name equals the name asked for: Inc / Incorporated, LLC / L.L.C. / Limited Liability Company, a trailing full stop and & vs and all match; names that merely start with it come back separately as also_starting_with. Each hit has entity_id, name, kind (corporation or llc), status, status reason and date, formation date, state of formation and principal office. THE DATA IS STALE AND CUT SHORT: the newest LLC formation in the published table is 2022-06-16 (the LLC table stops at exactly 1,048,575 rows) and the newest corporation is 2024-11-09. Every response states the measured newest formation date per table in data_as_of, so found:false never means "no such Virginia company": an entity formed after those dates is absent. No individuals are served (no officers, no registered agent names).

name.description: Company name, e.g. "Acme Motor Company, Inc." or "Furious Sauces LLC".

status.description: Filter by status (default any; pending-inactive counts as inactive).

name: va_scc_entity
description: The Virginia State Corporation Commission record for one corporation or LLC by its entity id (SCC id, e.g. "S5515129" or "11376405" for an LLC, "00241224" for a corporation): name, status and reason, status date, formation date, state of formation, principal office, and the type-specific flags (LLC industry code and series flags; corporation stock indicator and total shares). THE DATA IS STALE AND CUT SHORT: newest LLC formation 2022-06-16, newest corporation 2024-11-09, stated measured in data_as_of on every response; an id not found is not proof the entity does not exist. No individuals are served (no officers, no registered agent). Get the id from va_scc_search_entities.

entity_id.description: SCC entity id: as the SCC prints it, e.g. "S5515129", "11376405" or "00241224" (leading zeros may be left off a numeric id).

name: va_scc_new_entities
description: Virginia corporations and LLCs formed on or after a date in the State Corporation Commission, Clerk's Information System tables, newest first, with entity id, name, kind, status, formation date and principal office. THE DATA STOPS EARLY: the newest LLC formation in the table is 2022-06-16 and the newest corporation 2024-11-09, so a since date after those returns nothing and says why per table. It is a history feed to those dates, not a live feed of new Virginia businesses. data_as_of states the measured newest formation per table. No individuals are served.

since.description: Formation date on or after, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-10-01".

name_query.description: Only names containing this text, e.g. "dental".
